newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia GDP to allow for jobs method change.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia GDP to allow for jobs method change.

text.p: The Australian Bureau of Statistics will take into account distortions in its latest jobs data when calculating December quarter gross domestic product (GDP), a spokesman said.

The bureau said its introduction of telephone interviewing has affected its labour force data. The workforce estimate is now lower than it would have been had the survey method not changed, the bureau says.
But a spokesman for the bureau's national accounts section said the data used to calculate GDP will be adjusted in some way to allow for that.
December quarter GDP will be issued on March 5.
